title: WebAssembly - Non-trapping float-to-int conversions
product-requirement: Terminals MUST implement WebAssembly nontrapping-fptoint feature
specification: Terminals MUST support saturating float-to-int conversions (i32.trunc_sat_f32_s, etc.)
assertion: WebAssembly saturating truncation instructions return saturated values instead of trapping

changelog.summary: Initial creation of nontrapping-fptoint feature test
